title: Occupation-Measure Mean-Field Control: Optimization over Measures and Frank-Wolfe Methods
summary: Coordinating large populations of autonomous agents, such as UAV swarms or satellite constellations, poses significant computational challenges for traditional multi-agent control methods. This paper introduces a new optimization framework for large-population control, termed occupation-measure mean-field control (OM-MFC).
